fields.title: 📖 Ijmāʿ: Nafaqah is obligatory by the Book, the Sunnah and consensus
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Qudāmah** explained:

> ***“Ibn Qudāmah said: The Nafaqah of the wife is obligatory by the Qurʾān, the Sunnah and Ijmāʿ.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Family fiqh is not mere custom. The rights of the wife belong to the ordered duties of the Sharīʿah.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Qudāmah, al-Mughnī, Kitāb an-Nafaqāt, Bāb: al-Ḥālah allatī Tajib fīhā an-Nafaqah ʿalā az-Zawj.
